Title: Sub-Desktop Window Attachment
Statement: Render wallpaper behind desktop icons (SysListView32) while preserving icon selection, click, and desktop context menus.
Rationale: Core live wallpaper desktop experience without obstructing shell usability.
AcceptanceCriteria: Window HWND positioned beneath SHELLDLL_DefView; mouse drag-selection marquee and right-click menus function normally.
VerificationMethod: Win32 Z-order inspection and synthetic mouse input testing.
RisksAndConstraints: Relies on undocumented 0x052C message to Progman. Microsoft provides no guarantee.

Title: Explorer Restart Recovery
Statement: Invalidate obsolete HWNDs, re-negotiate desktop attachment, and restore wallpaper within 2.0s when explorer.exe restarts.
Rationale: Shell crashes and GPU driver resets restart Explorer; engine must not orphan windows or freeze.
AcceptanceCriteria: Listens for TaskbarCreated; re-attaches within 2.0s of Explorer relaunch without leaking resources.
VerificationMethod: Shell kill test during video playback; assert recovery.
RisksAndConstraints: Rapid window creation during boot can cause race conditions; needs backoff.

Title: Attachment Fallback Mode
Statement: Log failure and safely fallback to borderless window or restore static wallpaper if WorkerW attachment fails.
Rationale: Avoids application panic on third-party shells or restricted enterprise environments.
AcceptanceCriteria: 3-attempt retry with 250ms backoff; restores original desktop wallpaper via SystemParametersInfoW.
VerificationMethod: Fault injection returning failure on WorkerW creation; assert clean fallback and log.
RisksAndConstraints: Fallback window may sit above desktop icons if WorkerW is rejected entirely.

Title: Desktop State Restoration on Exit
Statement: Close player windows and signal Windows shell to redraw original wallpaper upon shutdown or crash.
Rationale: Prevents leaving black or frozen screens on user desktop upon exit.
AcceptanceCriteria: Traps WM_CLOSE, SIGTERM; destroys windows; dispatches RedrawWindow / SystemParametersInfoW.
VerificationMethod: Termination test verifying desktop background displays default static wallpaper cleanly.
RisksAndConstraints: Hard termination cannot run cleanup; requires watchdog supervisor.

Title: Core Controller Daemon
Statement: Native Rust daemon supervising configuration, display events, player lifecycle, tray icon, and IPC.
Rationale: Decouples orchestration from media decoders for maximum system uptime and low idle RAM.
AcceptanceCriteria: Standalone native Rust binary; maintains tray icon; supervises players; handles OS broadcasts.
VerificationMethod: Process inspection verifying runtime memory and tray responsiveness.
RisksAndConstraints: Thread-safety across IPC and Win32 event loops must be verified.

Title: Isolated Wallpaper Players
Statement: Media playback and web rendering run in isolated child processes out-of-process from the core daemon.
Rationale: Decoder or browser crashes do not compromise the core controller daemon or Windows desktop.
AcceptanceCriteria: Media decoders run in separate processes; killing a player does not terminate kinetiwall-core.
VerificationMethod: Process kill test terminating player process; assert core daemon logs crash and survives.
RisksAndConstraints: Inter-process HWND parenting requires synchronization.

Title: Ephemeral On-Demand UI Process
Statement: Gallery and settings UI runs as an on-demand process that terminates completely when closed; never lingering in background.
Rationale: Prevents 50-150 MB UI framework memory bloat while wallpaper runs in background.
AcceptanceCriteria: Closing gallery UI window completely terminates the UI process within 1.0s; core daemon continues.
VerificationMethod: Process monitoring during and after closing gallery UI window.
RisksAndConstraints: Requires fast UI cold boot times (<1.5s).

Title: Secure Named Pipe IPC
Statement: Daemon, UI, and players communicate via Windows Named Pipes with strict schema validation.
Rationale: Fast low-overhead local IPC with native Windows SID access security.
AcceptanceCriteria: Pipe DACL restricted to current user SID; schema-validated payloads; command latency < 15ms.
VerificationMethod: IPC benchmark measuring throughput latency and rejection of malformed messages.
RisksAndConstraints: Audio FFT arrays must not block high-priority command messages.

Title: Bounded Player Supervision
Statement: Core daemon enforces bounded restart policy (max 3 restarts in 60s) with exponential backoff on player crash.
Rationale: Prevents infinite crash loops from consuming 100% CPU and spamming event logs.
AcceptanceCriteria: Restarts tracked per display; suspends auto-restarts after 3 crashes in 60s; alerts user via tray notification.
VerificationMethod: Crash injection test asserting supervisor halts restarts after 3 attempts.
RisksAndConstraints: Must reset error counters after 5 minutes of continuous successful playback.

Title: Core Video Containers (MP4 WebM AVI)
Statement: Video player decodes and renders MP4 WebM and AVI container formats with standard modern video codecs.
Rationale: Satisfies >90% of user media clips and live wallpapers.
AcceptanceCriteria: Plays test files in H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, VP8, VP9; scales cleanly to display dimensions.
VerificationMethod: Media test suite verifying decode and presentation timestamps on test media.
RisksAndConstraints: Codec availability on Windows N editions missing Media Feature Pack.

Title: Extended Container Evaluation (MKV)
Statement: Evaluate and support Matroska (.mkv) container playback subject to decoder and licensing constraints.
Rationale: Popular container in enthusiast video collections.
AcceptanceCriteria: Plays standard H.264/HEVC/VP9 streams inside MKV containers without crashing on unsupported subtitle tracks.
VerificationMethod: Media verification test loading reference MKV clips.
RisksAndConstraints: WMF native MKV support has codec limitations compared to libmpv/FFmpeg.

Title: Hardware-Accelerated Decoding
Statement: Offload video decoding to GPU (D3D11VA DXVA2) by default.
Rationale: Keeps CPU usage under 2-3% preventing laptop battery drain and thermal throttling.
AcceptanceCriteria: Initializes hardware decode context; 1080p60 H.264 CPU usage <= 3.0% on reference hardware; Direct3D swapchain rendering.
VerificationMethod: Benchmark measuring CPU and GPU decode engine counters during playback.
RisksAndConstraints: Older iGPUs or VM virtual adapters may fail HW init; requires fallback.

Title: Seamless Gapless Looping
Statement: Loop video clips smoothly without visible black frames, stutter, audio pops, or dropped frames at the boundary.
Rationale: Visible stutter every few seconds ruins wallpaper immersion.
AcceptanceCriteria: Inter-frame jitter at loop boundary < 16.6ms at 60Hz; zero black or cleared frames presented.
VerificationMethod: Frame-time profiling over 50 consecutive loop transitions.
RisksAndConstraints: Seek/flush latency in decoders requires pre-buffering or double-buffering.

Title: Video Playback Controls
Statement: Provide responsive Play, Pause, Stop, Seek, Volume, and Mute controls via IPC.
Rationale: Essential user control over media playback and system audio mixing.
AcceptanceCriteria: Pause halts within 50ms; Volume adjusts smoothly without popping; default audio is muted.
VerificationMethod: IPC command integration test asserting decoder state changes.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Software Decoding Fallback
Statement: Fallback automatically to software CPU decoding if GPU hardware acceleration fails.
Rationale: Prevents black screens on unsupported hardware or broken graphics drivers.
AcceptanceCriteria: Hardware init failure triggers software decode fallback; playback continues; logs warning.
VerificationMethod: Test with disabled HW acceleration flags; verify successful CPU decoding.
RisksAndConstraints: Higher CPU utilization in software mode; UI must display warning.

Title: Interactive Web Runtime
Statement: Render HTML5, CSS animations, JavaScript, Canvas 2D, and WebGL2 interactive wallpapers.
Rationale: Enables interactive clocks, generative art, and particle simulations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Executes modern web standards and WebGL2 shaders at steady 60 FPS on capable hardware.
VerificationMethod: WebGL particle simulation benchmark verifying framerate and zero JS errors.
RisksAndConstraints: Higher memory usage (80-180 MB) than video players.

Title: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Hosting
Statement: Host Chromium-based WebView2 embedded within a borderless Win32 window behind desktop icons.
Rationale: Uses system-installed browser engine; avoids bundling massive Chromium binaries.
AcceptanceCriteria: Embedded CoreWebView2Controller; disables devtools, context menus, and scrollbars; isolates cache.
VerificationMethod: Integration test instantiating WebView2 controller behind desktop icons.
RisksAndConstraints: Systems without WebView2 need installation detection and guidance.

Title: Web Security Sandbox & Isolation
Statement: Restrict web wallpaper access to local filesystem, command execution, and local network.
Rationale: Protects host from malicious scripts in third-party web wallpapers.
AcceptanceCriteria: Serves via virtual host mapping (https://kinetiwall.local/); blocks file://; denies camera/mic/notifications.
VerificationMethod: Penetration test attempting to read system files from web wallpaper JS.
RisksAndConstraints: Must allow relative paths to local assets within the wallpaper directory.

Title: Web Customization Bridge
Statement: Inject window.kinetiwall JS API for dynamic property changes and audio FFT data stream.
Rationale: Enables web wallpapers to respond to user settings and music in real time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Delivers property updates via onPropertyChange; delivers normalized FFT spectrum arrays via onAudioData.
VerificationMethod: Integration test verifying IPC message delivery to web page DOM.
RisksAndConstraints: JSON serialization overhead of FFT data must be optimized.

Title: Per-Display Independent Mode
Statement: Assign distinct independent wallpapers and settings to each active monitor.
Rationale: Multi-monitor users expect independent control per display.
AcceptanceCriteria: Enumerates monitors; assigns separate wallpaper engine and volume profile per display HWND.
VerificationMethod: Multi-monitor test fixture verifying independent rendering across 2+ displays.
RisksAndConstraints: Multiple video players increase GPU decode session count.

Title: Multi-Display Spanning Mode
Statement: Span a single panoramic wallpaper across the combined virtual desktop bounds of all monitors.
Rationale: Ultra-wide and multi-monitor setups benefit from seamless panoramic scenes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Computes virtual desktop bounding box; scales unified wallpaper across all display coordinates.
VerificationMethod: Layout test verifying virtual screen calculation across multi-monitor topology.
RisksAndConstraints: Mismatched monitor resolutions/DPI cause bezel alignment discontinuities.

Title: Multi-Display Duplicate/Clone Mode
Statement: Duplicate the same wallpaper across all displays with synchronized frame playback and single audio.
Rationale: Ideal for mirrored displays or synchronized ambient aesthetics.
AcceptanceCriteria: Presents identical wallpaper across all monitors; video playback is synchronized without audio echo.
VerificationMethod: Multi-monitor test asserting identical frame presentation and single audio stream.
RisksAndConstraints: Independent decoders drift; requires shared clock or shared texture presentation.

Title: Display Hotplug & Topology Handling
Statement: Dynamically adapt to monitor connect/disconnect, resolution changes, and orientation shifts without restart.
Rationale: Mobile laptops frequently connect and disconnect from external displays.
AcceptanceCriteria: Intercepts WM_DISPLAYCHANGE; re-enumerates monitors and updates window geometry within 500ms.
VerificationMethod: Simulated display change test sending WM_DISPLAYCHANGE; assert layout adaptation.
RisksAndConstraints: Rapid docking can produce bursts of events; requires 500ms debounce.

Title: Per-Monitor V2 DPI Scaling
Statement: All windows adapt dynamically to WM_DPICHANGED across mixed-DPI multi-monitor environments.
Rationale: Prevents blurred rendering and coordinate drift on mixed-scaling setups.
AcceptanceCriteria: Manifest declares PerMonitorV2; window bounds and swapchains match physical pixel dimensions.
VerificationMethod: Multi-DPI testing across 100% 150% and 200% displays.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Fullscreen Game & App Detection
Statement: Detect exclusive or borderless fullscreen applications and trigger resource-saving states within 150ms.
Rationale: Wallpapers must not steal GPU or CPU resources from games or 3D benchmarks.
AcceptanceCriteria: Detects foreground window matching/exceeding monitor bounds or QUNS_RUNNING_D3D_FULL_SCREEN within 150ms.
VerificationMethod: Automated test launching a borderless fullscreen window; assert detection.
RisksAndConstraints: Desktop shell overlays must be filtered to prevent false positives.

Title: Discrete Deactivation States
Statement: Implement distinct states: Playback Paused, Rendering Suspended, Player Stopped, Static Fallback.
Rationale: Provides flexible tradeoffs between rapid resume and maximum resource freeing.
AcceptanceCriteria: Paused: CPU drops to 0.0% in 100ms; Stopped: releases GPU video surfaces; Resume < 50ms from pause.
VerificationMethod: Performance profiling verifying thread states and VRAM allocations across states.
RisksAndConstraints: Re-initializing a stopped player process incurs higher latency than resuming pause.

Title: Maximized Window Occlusion
Statement: Detect when a monitor's desktop is fully occluded by maximized windows and pause wallpaper on that monitor.
Rationale: Rendering wallpaper behind opaque maximized windows needlessly consumes power.
AcceptanceCriteria: Detects foreground window is IsZoomed covering work area; pauses rendering on that monitor.
VerificationMethod: Occlusion test maximizing a window on Monitor 1 while leaving Monitor 2 clear.
RisksAndConstraints: Translucent windows (Mica/Acrylic) may require configurable occlusion sensitivity.

Title: Event-Driven Window Hooks
Statement: Track foreground and window state changes using SetWinEventHook rather than high-frequency polling.
Rationale: Eliminates constant timer wakeups, preserving laptop battery life.
AcceptanceCriteria: Uses EVENT_SYSTEM_FOREGROUND and EVENT_OBJECT_LOCATIONCHANGE; idle CPU < 0.1%.
VerificationMethod: CPU profiler trace during 10-minute idle desktop; verify absence of busy loops.
RisksAndConstraints: Event hooks can miss events during lock screen; requires 2000ms safety watchdog.

Title: Battery Mode Adaptation
Statement: Detect transition to battery power and execute configured policy (pause, throttle FPS, or static image).
Rationale: Maximizes laptop battery life when running untethered.
AcceptanceCriteria: Intercepts WM_POWERBROADCAST; detects ACLineStatus == 0; triggers policy within 1.0s.
VerificationMethod: Power broadcast simulation test; assert policy execution and AC recovery.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Windows Battery Saver Integration
Statement: Automatically pause all rendering engines when Windows Battery Saver mode is engaged.
Rationale: Honors the operating system's explicit low-power state.
AcceptanceCriteria: Detects SystemStatusFlag == 1; immediately pauses or stops all active players.
VerificationMethod: Simulated Battery Saver toggle; assert player pause.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: WASAPI Loopback Capture
Statement: Capture system audio output using WASAPI in loopback mode exclusively when an audio-reactive wallpaper is active.
Rationale: Delivers real-time system audio data to drive visual effects in sync with music.
AcceptanceCriteria: Opt-in capture from default render endpoint; terminates capture thread when no audio wallpaper is active.
VerificationMethod: Audio test playing test tone; assert captured PCM samples in volatile memory.
RisksAndConstraints: Requires endpoint re-init when user changes default playback device.

Title: Real-Time FFT Spectrum Analysis
Statement: Compute real-time FFT spectrum analysis into normalized frequency bands and stream to active players.
Rationale: Wallpapers need frequency magnitude bins rather than raw audio waveforms.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dedicated thread runs FFT (Hann window, 1024/2048); streams 30-60 updates/sec; CPU overhead < 0.5%.
VerificationMethod: DSP test feeding known sine waves; assert dominant peaks in corresponding FFT bins.
RisksAndConstraints: High-frequency IPC data transfer must avoid heap fragmentation.

Title: Audio Privacy & Dynamic Switching
Statement: Process audio strictly in memory without recording; sleep during silence; re-bind on device change.
Rationale: Guarantees privacy against eavesdropping and eliminates idle CPU drain.
AcceptanceCriteria: Zero audio recording or network code; sleeps after >3s silence; auto-rebinds within 500ms on device change.
VerificationMethod: Privacy audit verifying no audio disk writes; device switch test asserting recovery.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Local Media & Package Import
Statement: Support importing local video files and web wallpaper directories via drag-and-drop or file dialog.
Rationale: Users must easily add their own video clips and web packages to their library.
AcceptanceCriteria: Imports MP4, WebM, AVI, and web folders; validates structure; adds to local library catalog.
VerificationMethod: Automated file import test suite validating catalog entries.
RisksAndConstraints: Very large files (>2GB) should be linked rather than duplicated.

Title: Local Metadata Store
Statement: Store wallpaper metadata (title, tags, properties, favorites) in an embedded local database (SQLite/JSON).
Rationale: Fast search, filtering, and sorting across thousands of assets without re-scanning disk.
AcceptanceCriteria: Queries execute in <20ms for 10,000 items; schema versioning and automatic migration support.
VerificationMethod: Performance benchmark querying 5000 items in local store.
RisksAndConstraints: Database corruption recovery mechanism required.

Title: Thumbnail Generation & Cache
Statement: Automatically extract representative video frames or web snapshots and cache preview thumbnails.
Rationale: Fast gallery scrolling requires pre-computed thumbnail images.
AcceptanceCriteria: Extracts frame at 10% timestamp; saves WebP/JPEG thumbnail; runs in background without UI lag.
VerificationMethod: Test importing 20 video files; assert 20 valid thumbnail files generated in cache.
RisksAndConstraints: Video decode extraction must prioritize visible viewport items.

Title: Library Search Filtering & Favorites
Statement: Provide real-time search by title/tag, filter by wallpaper type, and toggle favorites.
Rationale: Rapid organization and retrieval of growing wallpaper collections.
AcceptanceCriteria: Search updates results in <50ms; filters isolate video/web; favorites persist across restarts.
VerificationMethod: UI functional test executing search queries and filter combinations.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Runtime Property Customization
Statement: Adjust wallpaper playback speed, brightness, saturation, volume, and custom sliders/colors live via IPC.
Rationale: Personalize wallpaper aesthetics without reloading or restarting player processes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Slider change updates running wallpaper in <30ms; color picker updates shader uniforms live.
VerificationMethod: Integration test verifying IPC property update dispatch to running player.
RisksAndConstraints: Video color adjustments require hardware shader support or video filters.

Title: Property Schema Validation
Statement: Declare custom properties in JSON manifest; strictly validate, clamp, and sanitize values before applying.
Rationale: Prevents out-of-range values (e.g. NaN, negative speed) from crashing players.
AcceptanceCriteria: Validates property types; clamps out-of-range numbers; handles malformed schemas gracefully.
VerificationMethod: Unit tests exercising schema parser with valid, out-of-bound, and malformed JSON.
RisksAndConstraints: Compatibility with third-party manifest schemas (Lively/Wallpaper Engine).

Title: Reliable Configuration Persistence
Statement: Persist user settings and monitor assignments atomically to disk (settings.json) with backup protection.
Rationale: Settings must survive sudden system power loss or process kill.
AcceptanceCriteria: Writes via atomic file replacement (write temp -> FlushFileBuffers -> MoveFileExW); versioned schema.
VerificationMethod: Sudden process kill test during save; assert file integrity upon restart.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: System Tray Quick Controls
Statement: Display tray icon with responsive context menu (Gallery, Play/Pause, Next, Mute, Display, Exit).
Rationale: Unintrusive, quick access to core controls without taskbar clutter.
AcceptanceCriteria: Registers via Shell_NotifyIconW; right-click menu opens in <50ms; restores icon on TaskbarCreated.
VerificationMethod: Win32 message test asserting tray registration and menu dispatch.
RisksAndConstraints: DPI scaling of tray icon assets across mixed-DPI displays.

Title: Run on Windows Startup
Statement: Provide optional setting to start silently into system tray on Windows user login via HKCU\...Run.
Rationale: Live wallpapers are expected to be active automatically upon desktop login.
AcceptanceCriteria: Creates/removes HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run entry; launches silently to tray.
VerificationMethod: Registry inspection and startup command line parameter test.
RisksAndConstraints: Antivirus software monitors Run key writes; clear intent required.

Title: Single-Instance Enforcement
Statement: Enforce single-instance policy per user session using a named Mutex; second launch focuses existing instance.
Rationale: Prevents duplicate background daemons, multiple tray icons, and conflicting window attachments.
AcceptanceCriteria: Creates named session mutex; second instance signals existing daemon to open UI and exits in <200ms.
VerificationMethod: Launch collision test; assert only one core process remains active.
RisksAndConstraints: Mutex abandonment must be handled cleanly.

Title: Native 3D Executable Hosting Evaluation
Statement: Evaluate feasibility, security boundaries, and lifecycle of hosting standalone 3D executables (Unity/Godot).
Rationale: Proposed in research to support complex 3D scenes; requires strict risk analysis.
AcceptanceCriteria: Feasibility and security study documenting window parenting risks, anti-cheat conflicts, and crash risks.
VerificationMethod: Architectural spike evaluating SetParent vs out-of-process IPC rendering.
RisksAndConstraints: Running unsigned executables poses severe malware and stability risks.

Title: 100% Offline Core Operability
Statement: All core wallpaper playback, library management, and customization must work completely offline.
Rationale: Users must never be prevented from using desktop customization during internet outages.
AcceptanceCriteria: Functions 100% with network adapters disabled; zero blocking network timeouts or failed requests.
VerificationMethod: Offline test suite executed on network-disabled machine; assert full pass.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Self-Contained Dependency Packaging
Statement: Bundle all required runtime libraries in offline installer or rely strictly on standard Windows runtimes.
Rationale: Eliminates failed installations caused by missing online downloaders or blocked firewalls.
AcceptanceCriteria: Installs and runs successfully on an air-gapped machine; clear detection/bundling for WebView2.
VerificationMethod: Clean installation on isolated offline Windows 10/11 virtual machine.
RisksAndConstraints: Bundling fixed-version WebView2 increases installer size by ~150MB.

Title: Idle Core Controller RAM
Statement: Daemon private working set RAM remains <= 15 MB (provisional target: < 10 MB) when UI is closed.
Rationale: Background utility must not crowd out active applications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Measured Private Working Set <= 15.0 MB during continuous 1-hour idle monitoring.
VerificationMethod: Automated performance benchmark sampling Process.WorkingSet64 over 60 mins.
RisksAndConstraints: Handle and pipe buffers must be managed to avoid leaks.

Title: Idle Core Controller CPU
Statement: Core controller consumes < 0.1% average CPU utilization when idle on desktop.
Rationale: Background daemons must not prevent CPU core sleep states.
AcceptanceCriteria: Average CPU over 10-minute idle desktop < 0.10%; uses blocking OS waits, no busy loops.
VerificationMethod: Windows Performance Toolkit trace capturing CPU thread execution states.
RisksAndConstraints: Global Windows timer resolution must not be forced to 1ms.

Title: Active Video Player CPU
Statement: 1080p60 H.264 hardware-accelerated playback consumes <= 3.0% CPU on reference quad-core hardware.
Rationale: Video decoding must be offloaded to dedicated GPU fixed-function hardware.
AcceptanceCriteria: Average CPU <= 3.0% over 5-minute playback; 3D GPU engine utilization <= 5.0%.
VerificationMethod: Benchmark measuring CPU and GPU engine performance counters.
RisksAndConstraints: High-bitrate 4K VP9/AV1 may require higher CPU baseline.

Title: Rapid Suspension Latency
Statement: Halt rendering and suspend video decoding within 100 ms (provisional target: < 50 ms) of pause event.
Rationale: Immediate pause prevents framerate stutter during game launch.
AcceptanceCriteria: Time between trigger event and last swapchain frame <= 100 ms; CPU drops to 0.0% in <150ms.
VerificationMethod: Timestamped event logging capturing trigger vs decoder pause confirmation.
RisksAndConstraints: Non-blocking pipe messaging and decoder synchronization required.

Title: Zero Gaming Frame-Time Impact
Statement: 0.0% degradation in 99th percentile frame times or average FPS in fullscreen games when paused.
Rationale: Gamers will uninstall any customization tool that degrades gaming smoothness.
AcceptanceCriteria: 3D benchmark exhibits statistically indistinguishable FPS (+/-0.5%) paused vs uninstalled.
VerificationMethod: Comparative benchmark running 10 iterations of graphics test active vs uninstalled.
RisksAndConstraints: Verify across both NVIDIA and AMD driver architectures.

Title: Compact Installer Size
Statement: Core standalone installer achieves compressed distribution size <= 35 MB (provisional target: < 25 MB).
Rationale: Compact downloads improve adoption and reduce bandwidth overhead.
AcceptanceCriteria: Production release installer .exe byte size <= 35.0 MB.
VerificationMethod: Build artifact inspection measuring installer binary size in release CI.
RisksAndConstraints: Bundling full static libmpv or offline WebView2 will exceed 35MB.

Title: 72-Hour Continuous Stability
Statement: Run continuously for at least 72 hours of uninterrupted playback without crashing or leaking memory.
Rationale: Live wallpapers run indefinitely as part of the operating system shell.
AcceptanceCriteria: Zero unhandled crashes across 72 hours; memory growth <= 10% of initial baseline.
VerificationMethod: 72-hour continuous stress test logging memory, handles, and playback state every 5m.
RisksAndConstraints: Third-party decoders must be audited for unmanaged leaks.

Title: Sleep / Modern Standby Recovery
Statement: Handle S3/S0ix sleep and resume cleanly, rebuilding Direct3D swapchains within 2.0s of wake.
Rationale: Sleep/wake cycles frequently reset Direct3D device contexts (DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_RESET).
AcceptanceCriteria: Intercepts WM_POWERBROADCAST; restores live rendering within 2.0s of wake without user input.
VerificationMethod: Automated sleep/wake cycle testing via Windows Power Management scripts.
RisksAndConstraints: Device removed errors require rebuilding swapchains from scratch.

Title: Corrupt Media Resilience
Statement: Truncated or corrupt media files fail safely without crashing player processes or freezing Windows shell.
Rationale: Users will encounter malformed downloads or unsupported codec profiles.
AcceptanceCriteria: Parser detects invalid headers; transitions to error state; logs error; notifies UI.
VerificationMethod: Fuzz testing injecting corrupted, zero-byte, and truncated video files.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Job Object Process Guardrails
Statement: Assign all player subprocesses to a Windows Job Object with KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE to kill orphans.
Rationale: Guarantees kernel-level cleanup of all child rendering processes if daemon terminates.
AcceptanceCriteria: Job Object configured; killing kinetiwall-core terminates all child player processes immediately.
VerificationMethod: Kill test terminating parent process and verifying child process destruction via PowerShell.
RisksAndConstraints: Compatibility with WebView2 child processes must be verified.

Title: Least-Privilege Execution
Statement: Execute entirely within standard non-elevated user context; never requiring Administrator privileges.
Rationale: Running customization tools as Administrator exposes host system to privilege escalation attacks.
AcceptanceCriteria: requestedExecutionLevel level=asInvoker; all features work without UAC prompts.
VerificationMethod: Security audit executing inside standard non-admin account; assert zero UAC prompts.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Named Pipe DACL Security
Statement: Restrict Named Pipe connections exclusively to current user SID, rejecting unauthorized local access.
Rationale: Open named pipes allow unprivileged local processes to inject commands or hijack execution.
AcceptanceCriteria: Pipe created with SID-restricted DACL; connections from other accounts fail with access denied.
VerificationMethod: Security test running unprivileged secondary account attempting pipe connection.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Strict IPC Schema Validation
Statement: Validate all IPC payloads against strict schemas; reject oversized (>64KB/1MB) or malformed packets.
Rationale: Protects against buffer overflows, denial-of-service, and command injection attacks.
AcceptanceCriteria: Deserializer rejects unknown fields or payloads exceeding byte limits; resets connection cleanly.
VerificationMethod: Fuzzing test sending malformed and oversized byte sequences to IPC listener.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Zip Slip Archive Protection
Statement: Forbid directory traversal (../, absolute paths, symlinks) during wallpaper archive extraction.
Rationale: Malicious wallpaper archives could attempt to overwrite auto-start programs or system files.
AcceptanceCriteria: Canonical path validation ensures all extracted files reside inside target destination directory.
VerificationMethod: Security test attempting extraction of zip containing ../../evil.exe; assert abort.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Dependency Vulnerability Audits
Statement: Continuous automated security audits (cargo audit, npm audit) with zero high/critical CVEs allowed.
Rationale: Guarantees third-party dependencies are free from known exploits and vulnerabilities.
AcceptanceCriteria: CI pipeline runs cargo audit and cargo deny; builds fail on unpatched high-severity CVEs.
VerificationMethod: Automated CI security scan step execution.
RisksAndConstraints: Requires timely updates when upstream vulnerabilities are discovered.

Title: Web Sandbox Storage Segregation
Statement: WebView2 user data folder isolated from host Edge browser cookies credentials and passwords.
Rationale: Prevents web wallpapers from accessing user web sessions or saved passwords.
AcceptanceCriteria: User data folder points to %LOCALAPPDATA%\KinetiWall\web_cache; cannot read host Edge credentials.
VerificationMethod: Inspection of WebView2 initialization parameters and directory isolation.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Absolute Telemetry Prohibition
Statement: Zero telemetry SDKs, analytics tracking, behavioral logging, or outbound network reporting.
Rationale: User desktop customization utilities have no justification for tracking user habits.
AcceptanceCriteria: Zero telemetry dependencies in codebase; zero outbound network packets over 24-hour capture.
VerificationMethod: Static binary string inspection and dynamic Wireshark packet capture analysis.
RisksAndConstraints: Crash debugging relies on local opt-in logs rather than automated remote dumps.

Title: Anti-Screen-Scraping Guarantee
Statement: Never capture desktop screenshots, scrape pixels, or inspect open window contents.
Rationale: Customization tools must not act as covert surveillance tools or spyware.
AcceptanceCriteria: Queries only window bounds and styles; never invokes PrintWindow or graphics capture APIs.
VerificationMethod: Source code audit confirming absence of screen capture APIs.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Account-Free Sovereign Operation
Statement: Never prompt for account creation, email registration, or online login for any feature.
Rationale: Guarantees complete user sovereignty and frictionless setup without vendor lock-in.
AcceptanceCriteria: Complete installation playback and customization lifecycle proceeds with zero account dialogs.
VerificationMethod: Manual walkthrough of all user flows verifying zero registration prompts.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Progressive Disclosure UI
Statement: 1-click wallpaper selection for beginners; advanced multi-monitor/shader settings in sub-views.
Rationale: Avoids overwhelming casual users while providing deep customization for power users.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clean initial visual grid with immediate Apply; advanced tabs cleanly separated.
VerificationMethod: Usability walkthrough verifying key task completion within 3 clicks from launch.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Actionable Error Messaging
Statement: User-facing errors provide plain-language explanations and actions; technical logs saved to disk.
Rationale: Cryptic error codes frustrate users and cause avoidable support tickets.
AcceptanceCriteria: UI dialogs contain title explanation and action button; stack traces saved to log file.
VerificationMethod: Fault injection test validating UI error presentation and log file contents.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Keyboard & Accessibility Navigation
Statement: Gallery UI supports keyboard navigation (Tab, Arrows, Enter, Esc), visible focus, and ARIA labels.
Rationale: Ensures accessibility for users relying on keyboard navigation or screen readers.
AcceptanceCriteria: All gallery items and controls can be navigated and activated via keyboard alone.
VerificationMethod: Accessibility audit and manual keyboard-only navigation test.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Supported Windows OS Matrix
Statement: Support Windows 10 (Build 19041+) and Windows 11 (all builds) 64-bit x86_64; reject older OS cleanly.
Rationale: Establishes modern Win32, WebView2, and Per-Monitor V2 DPI API baseline.
AcceptanceCriteria: Installs and runs on Win 10 22H2 and Win 11 23H2/24H2; older builds display warning and exit safely.
VerificationMethod: Virtual machine test runs on Windows 10 (19041, 19045) and Windows 11 (22631, 26100).
RisksAndConstraints: Windows 11 24H2 shell changes must be verified.

Title: Clean Uninstallation Footprint
Statement: Cleanly remove all binaries, registry keys, shortcuts, and offer wallpaper/config removal on uninstall.
Rationale: Prevents polluting user systems with leftover background daemons or registry keys.
AcceptanceCriteria: Terminates processes; removes binaries; deletes Run key; restores desktop wallpaper.
VerificationMethod: Clean install/uninstall cycle followed by filesystem and registry scanning for leftovers.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Reproducible Native Rust Build
Statement: Core components build reproducibly using stable Rust toolchain with locked dependencies (Cargo.lock).
Rationale: Guarantees long-term maintainability, deterministic compilation, and auditability.
AcceptanceCriteria: cargo build --release produces core binaries in <3 minutes without unmanaged scripts.
VerificationMethod: Clean build test: cargo clean followed by cargo build --release.
RisksAndConstraints: C/C++ dependencies require MSVC build tools.

Title: Modular Cargo Workspace
Statement: Organize codebase into isolated crates: core, player-video, player-web, ipc, common.
Rationale: Prevents monolithic coupling and speeds up compilation while enforcing process boundaries.
AcceptanceCriteria: Root Cargo.toml declares workspace members; zero circular dependencies between crates.
VerificationMethod: cargo tree and cargo check --workspace validation.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: Automated Test Coverage Baseline
Statement: Core modules (IPC serialization, layout geometry, power state logic) maintain >= 75% test coverage.
Rationale: Guarantees regression prevention across subsequent development steps.
AcceptanceCriteria: cargo test --workspace passes cleanly; code coverage tool reports >= 75% coverage.
VerificationMethod: CI automated test harness execution.
RisksAndConstraints: Win32 GUI window interactions require mock window handles.

Title: No Resident Gallery UI
Statement: The gallery/settings UI process must terminate completely upon window close; never lingering in background.
Rationale: Prevents 50-150 MB UI framework memory bloat while wallpaper runs in background.
AcceptanceCriteria: Window close triggers std::process::exit(0) on UI process; monitored by CI process lifetime tests.
VerificationMethod: Process monitoring during and after closing gallery UI window.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: No Telemetry or Spyware
Statement: No telemetry SDKs, analytics tracking, behavioral logging, or outbound network reporting.
Rationale: User desktop customization utilities have no justification for tracking user habits.
AcceptanceCriteria: Codebase dependency ban enforced by cargo deny; Wireshark network capture in CI.
VerificationMethod: Static binary string inspection and dynamic Wireshark packet capture analysis.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: No Mandatory Online Accounts
Statement: No required online accounts, email registration, OAuth authentication, or mandatory cloud logins.
Rationale: Guarantees complete user sovereignty and frictionless setup without vendor lock-in.
AcceptanceCriteria: Architecture verification; absence of authentication UI or remote login API endpoints.
VerificationMethod: Manual walkthrough of all user flows verifying zero registration prompts.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: No Explorer Shell DLL Injection
Statement: No DLL injection into explorer.exe or hooking undocumented internal Windows kernel routines.
Rationale: Preserves Windows stability and prevents anti-cheat false positives.
AcceptanceCriteria: Architecture strictly uses standard Win32 window message negotiation (SendMessageTimeoutW).
VerificationMethod: Architecture audit and binary import table analysis.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: No Audio Recording or Disk Saving
Statement: No raw audio waveform serialization to disk, recording, or audio streaming over network.
Rationale: Protects user audio privacy against surveillance concerns.
AcceptanceCriteria: Code audit confirming WASAPI PCM buffers exist only in volatile memory during FFT processing.
VerificationMethod: Source code inspection and disk write logging during audio visualization.
RisksAndConstraints: None.

Title: No Unsandboxed Remote Executables
Statement: No downloading and executing arbitrary unsigned .exe binaries as wallpapers without sandboxing.
Rationale: Protects host from malware disguised as live wallpaper executables.
AcceptanceCriteria: Library import explicitly rejects .exe, .bat, .cmd, .ps1 files from standard user import paths.
VerificationMethod: Security test attempting to import and launch executable files.
RisksAndConstraints: None.
